name: secure-e2e-chat
description: A lightweight browser-based end-to-end encrypted chat site.

scripts.lint: node --check config.js && node --check utils/http.js && node --check utils/data.js && node --check utils/normalize.js && node --check utils/rate-limit.js && node --check utils/crypto.js && node --check routes/account-routes.js && node --check routes/admin-routes.js && node --check routes/contact-routes.js && node --check routes/event-routes.js && node --check routes/message-routes.js && node --check routes/support-routes.js && node --check server.js && node --check middleware/access-log.js && node --check services/access-log-store.js && node --check services/admin-config.js && node --check services/message-store.js && node --check services/realtime-hub.js && node --check services/session-store.js && node --check services/static-file-server.js && node --check scripts/build-assets.js && node --check scripts/verify-build.js && node --check scripts/write-build-manifest.js && node --check public/ui-utils.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/admin.js && node --check public/admin-user.js && node --check tests/e2e.test.js
scripts.build: terser public/ui-utils.js --compress --mangle --output public/ui-utils.min.js && terser public/app.js --compress --mangle --output public/app.min.js && terser public/admin.js --compress --mangle --output public/admin.min.js && terser public/admin-user.js --compress --mangle --output public/admin-user.min.js && cleancss -o public/styles.min.css public/styles.css && cleancss -o public/admin.min.css public/admin.css && cleancss -o public/admin-user.min.css public/admin-user.css && node scripts/write-build-manifest.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run verify:build
scripts.test: node --test --test-name-pattern "browser client|client guards|deployment scripts|public auth endpoints|state-changing endpoints|event stream tickets" tests/e2e.test.js
